books.title: We Are Still Here! Native American Truths Everyone Should Know
books.author: Traci Sorell
books.about: A nonfiction picture book by a Cherokee author that explains important parts of Native American history, including assimilation and boarding schools, and how Native nations are still here today.
books.cite: Sorell, Traci. We Are Still Here! Native American Truths Everyone Should Know. Charlesbridge.
